builtin.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept. Create the final ORIGINAL 16:9 winter expedition-base homepage wallpaper by thoroughly REDRAWING the first input composition, not applying a surface filter. Image 1 is the NovelAI rough composition ONLY: keep a complete wide interior, snow window and central sitting/rest group; preserve navigation negative space on the LEFT 28 percent, departure-panel negative space in the LOWER-RIGHT 28 percent, and quiet TOP 13 percent resource-bar zone. Image 2 (Wu woman) is the approved PAINTING STYLE reference ONLY; no woman, animal or other character appears, do not copy her hair, eyes, fangs, clothes, weapon or identity. Subject: a real welcoming winter expeditioners' refuge, a small shared base rest room with an unoccupied simple gray-white upholstered loveseat/read-chair near horizontal centre. A casually folded MUTED TERRACOTTA RED wool blanket and one cream cushion make a clear single lived-in focal group. A small dark blue-gray side table next to it holds one plain ceramic cup and one closed book; a compact travel satchel rests immediately beside the chair. A small plain blue-gray woven rug directly beneath this single central group grounds it comfortably. One generous simple window behind the group shows a quiet snowbound BASE COURTYARD with broad desaturated silhouettes, not an empty surreal horizon. Cool paper-white/gray plaster walls and pale ash-colored sill surfaces; restrained dark-blue-gray architectural trim. Keep these props compact, not scattered around the room. The single central chair/blanket/cup group carries warmth and belonging. Correct the rough's sterile office finish: no padded office stripes, no shiny floor, no plastic reflections, no fluorescent lighting. The surrounding wall and floor planes are quiet, matte and broadly painted. Painting style: hand-painted ANIME environment, large OPAQUE economical angular paint masses, low detail density, clear HARD-EDGED planes of light and shadow, loose purposeful human-painted edges and visible simplified broad brush marks, a few coherent highlight/shadow groups like the reference's clothing. No photographic texture, glossy 3D, polished rendering, airbrush gradients or etched fine outlines. Colors: cool gray, desaturated deep blue-gray and paper-white dominate; the blanket's muted terracotta red is the only strong color. Gentle clear cool winter ambient light plus a very small restrained warm light within the same central rest group, no dramatic glowing spotlight. Avoid the previously rejected brown/gold room: no warm brown wood floor, golden wall cast, heavy beams, many lamps, decorative clutter or busy room. Keep the left margin and lower-right margin especially low texture without furniture, lamps, glyphs or architectural crossings. Preserve a genuine WIDE 16:9 composition, eye-level natural perspective, complete consistent room geometry. No people, pets, text, symbols, lettering, logos, interface, card borders or watermark. The output is just the full scene wallpaper, no baked-in UI.
